description: An authenticatable identity (FEAT-9 / #744) — conceptually a Principal of kind User in the access model. The on-disk user.json projection of the replicated `user:<uuid>` CRDT value. Mirrored by zetta::governance::User in include/zetta/governance/user.hpp and enforced by Node::load_users()/reconcile_users() in src/core/node.cpp — keep the three in sync.

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation stamp (millisecond precision, trailing 'Z').

id.description: The user's UUID — its CRDT key and on-disk folder name. Present in user.json (where the folder name is the source of truth) and omitted from the CRDT value (the key carries it).

name.description: The user's login/display name (unique among users).

status.description: Whether the user may authenticate. A disabled user's tokens stop validating.

title: User
